original_ai_output.title_zh: 脊髓灰质炎：扶轮社在伊巴丹为40名学生接种疫苗
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 伊巴丹市中心扶轮社周二在伊巴丹Oke-Bola社区发展幼儿园和小学为40名学生及社区其他儿童接种脊髓灰质炎疫苗。据尼日利亚通讯社报道，此次活动旨在纪念2026年世界脊髓灰质炎日。扶轮社主席呼吁家长和监护人确保五岁及以下儿童接种疫苗。

location.site: Oke-Bola社区发展幼儿园和小学
location.raw_text: Oke-Bola Community Development Nursery and Primary School, Ibadan

key_facts.fact: 伊巴丹市中心扶轮社为40名学生接种脊髓灰质炎疫苗
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The Rotary Club of Ibadan City Central on Tuesday vaccinated 40 pupils of Oke-Bola Community Development Nursery and Primary School, Ibadan, alongside other children in the community against polio.

key_facts.fact: 活动旨在纪念2026年世界脊髓灰质炎日
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: the club organised the vaccination to commemorate the 2026 World Polio Day

key_facts.fact: 扶轮社主席呼吁家长确保五岁及以下儿童接种疫苗
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: urged parents and guardians to ensure their children aged five and below receive vaccinations to protect them against polio

uncertainties: 单一来源：目前仅尼日利亚通讯社报道，尚缺乏交叉验证
